query: How do I reset my password?
answer: If you've forgotten your password or want to change it for security reasons, you can reset it from the login page. Click "Forgot Password?" below the login form, enter the email address associated with your account, and click "Send Reset Link." You will receive an email containing a secure link to reset your password.

query: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account dashboard. Go to Settings > Billing > Subscription, and click "Cancel Subscription." You will be asked to confirm your decision and may be offered an option to pause your subscription instead.

query: How do I download my invoice?
answer: To download your invoice, log in to your account and go to Settings > Billing > Payment History. Each transaction listed will have a corresponding "Download Invoice" link that generates a PDF copy of the invoice for that billing period.

query: How do I connect via API?
answer: To connect via API, you need to generate an API key from Settings > Developer > API Keys by clicking "Create New Key." Store this key securely, as it will only be shown once. All API requests must be authenticated using a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
